evals.prompt: Use $qa-find-bugs-mcp to find bugs. I have no MCP credential handy.
evals.expected_output: Runs the anonymous transport and discovery checks against the production endpoint with bounded requests (401 with a resolving discovery pointer, method set, notification and unknown-method handling), runs the observing conformance script, marks every authenticated journey unverified, asks for the credential variable name or file path rather than the value, and reports without board writes or pushing.

evals.prompt: Run $qa-find-bugs-mcp boundaries writes w4 SHIP=1 DRY_RUN=1. QA_MCP_TOKEN and QA_MCP_READONLY_TOKEN are in my environment and pinned to qa/mcp-books.
evals.expected_output: Uses the bundled helper so the tokens never reach argv or a transcript, checks that the read-only key gets isError FORBIDDEN on every write and admin tool, that dry_run leaves the ledger unchanged in a fresh request and via REST, and that real writes persist with one commit. DRY_RUN allows disposable writes on the designated ledger but prevents board edits, commits and push.

evals.prompt: Use $qa-find-bugs-mcp prompts. The served close-month prompt differs from mcp-prompts.ts and a w5 milestone already mentions it.
evals.expected_output: Fetches prompts/get, compares served text with HEAD, finds the commit that already changed it, classifies the difference as deployment lag rather than a new bug, checks the existing w5 item and its unblock condition instead of filing a duplicate, and still verifies that every tool and beancount:// URI the served prompt cites exists in the deployed inventory.

evals.prompt: Run $qa-find-bugs-mcp account limits against production with my personal API key.
evals.expected_output: Declines to use a personal account or ledger for account journeys and write-budget probes, does not call deleteAccount or change collaborators, banks or billing, points write, admin and rate-limit journeys at the already running local docker-mac stack or a designated QA account, refuses to provision a second stack, and continues the read-only production checks that need no personal data.

evals.prompt: Use $qa-find-bugs-mcp reads resources w4. runBqlQueryStructured returns a different decimal than REST query for the same BQL. Find and schedule the fix.
evals.expected_output: Reproduces from a fresh request with the same credential, captures the sanitized MCP and REST exchanges, traces the serializer to file:line in the shared service or adapter, names every eligible REST/GraphQL/MCP surface the fix must change together under the parity workflow, deduplicates across queues and history, and files through pm without implementing or shipping.
